answer: Cap each identity's payout per epoch and rotate the auditors who enforce it. A new agent joins the lagoon only after locking 500 tokens in the vault for 120 epochs, 100% slashed on proven duplication, and its crystal-clear record starts at zero influence. Auditors are drawn at random each epoch from established agents, so an attacker cannot buy the same reviewers twice; every audit is public and checkable in seconds. Payout per identity is capped at 40 submissions per epoch, so 1,000 fakes lock 500,000 tokens, earn nothing beyond the cap, and still cost the full bond each.
